description: This is a JavaScript localization file for the Select2 plugin, providing Hindi language translations for various UI strings used in the plugin.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns the Hindi translation for the error message when results cannot be loaded.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns the Hindi message prompting the user to remove excess characters.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns the Hindi message prompting the user to input more characters.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns the Hindi translation for the loading more results message.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns the Hindi message indicating the maximum number of items that can be selected.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns the Hindi message indicating no search results found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns the Hindi message indicating a search is in progress.
